_meta.note: The register of projects, who owns each, and which file each may write. Read by scripts/coordination.js and by the harness view. No secret, key or credential belongs in this file.

projects.name: WordPress sites
projects.done_when: Every connected site has a fetch result newer than the last sync, or a stated reason it does not.
projects.stops_when: A site returns 401 or 403 twice in a row. A wrong password is not a reason to keep trying.

projects.name: Content pipeline
projects.done_when: Every piece has a state that matches its evidence: a published URL fetched and matched, a ledger for every fact, a citation that is the same on the site and the listing.
projects.stops_when: A piece is ready to publish and the site module is returning 401. Escalate; do not draft around a site that cannot be read.

projects.name: Link inventory
projects.done_when: Every placement has a fetch result newer than the last check, with the status code and the anchor text that was seen.
projects.stops_when: A whole site is unreachable. Then the links on it are unknown, not lost, and the difference is written down.

projects.name: Central email
projects.done_when: Every sending domain has SPF, DKIM and DMARC recorded as seen, and every mailbox has a volume under its cap and a bounce rate under the warn line.
projects.stops_when: A domain is listed on a blocklist, or bounce is above the fail line. Pause it and say so; do not send through a bad domain to keep the volume up.

projects.name: EEAT and citations
projects.done_when: Every source is either verified, pending with an owner, or recorded as rejected with the reason. The entity details are the same on every entry that has them.
projects.stops_when: The entity details are incomplete. Fill them once rather than correcting ten listings to a guess.
